server.name: io.github.Sofiia7/actually
server.description: Matches news to Polymarket markets and returns the market's probability. Optional capped trading.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Polygon EOA private key. Enables the trading tools (place_order, sell_order, cancel_order, get_open_orders, get_positions). Omit to run signal-only, which needs no key and no wallet.
environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Per-order USD cap for the trading tools (default 100). Enforced server-side against the market's own price, so a caller cannot understate an order to slip past it.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_MAX_ORDER_USD

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Rolling UTC-day USD cap shared by place_order and sell_order (default 500). Held in a persisted ledger, so it survives restarts.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_DAILY_LIMIT_USD

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to additionally register redeem_position. A second opt-in beyond the private key, because it submits a real on-chain transaction through Polymarket's relayer and is still in testing.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_ENABLE_REDEEM

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to let check_news fall back to Polymarket's own market search when nothing in the cached set matches. Off by default: the query is built from the caller's text and leaves the machine.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_SEARCH_FALLBACK

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where the spend ledger is stored (default ~/.actually-mcp-server/spend-guard.json).
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_SPEND_STATE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only if you run your own Cloudflare Worker instead of the shared default.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Shared secret for your own Worker. Not a private credential: the default one ships inside every client by design.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_SECRET
